title: Resolution to approve a tax break for Bronx affordable housing
summary: The resolution approves a six-year real property tax exemption for a Bronx housing project at three lots owned by Neighborhood Renewal Housing Development Fund Corporation. The exemption runs from June 23, 2021 and depends on compliance with an affordable housing regulatory agreement with the Department of Housing Preservation and Development. It can end early if the owner violates program rules or transfers the property without HPD's approval.
